data.description:
## Summary

`skill/code_review/scripts/linter_runner.py` scoped-lint path hands the raw git changed-file list to eslint without an extension filter. When the changed-file list contains a Python file (.py), eslint v6.4.0 parses it as JavaScript and emits a fatal "Parsing error: Unterminated string constant" — surfaced as a blocking high-severity finding that fails audits closed (Phase 1 decision gate), even though the flagged file is valid Python and unrelated to the item under audit.

discovered-from:SA-0MSKM2LSP006L0K8

## Root cause

- `_run_eslint_findings_check` (`skill/code_review/scripts/linter_runner.py:351`): `cmd = ["eslint", *[str(f) for f in files], "-f", "json", "--quiet"]` — passes raw `files` with no extension filter.
- `_run_eslint_fix_mode` (`:722`, `:727`): same gap.
- By contrast, ruff scoping filters to Python extensions: `py_files = [f for f in files if str(f).endswith((".py", ".pyi", ".pyx"))]` (`:392`, `:641`).
- Consequence (observed 2026-09-20): audit of SA-0MSKM2LSP006L0K8 returned "Ready to close: No" because an unrelated uncommitted `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py` modification entered the changed-file scope and eslint mis-parsed it, demoting a previously completed/in_review item to open/plan_complete.

## Reproduction (read-only)

eslint skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py -f json --quiet  -> fatal "Parsing error: Unterminated string constant" (1:3)
eslint skill/audit/scripts/scan.py -f json --quiet             -> identical error (unrelated committed .py)
eslint tests/node/<any>.mjs -f json --quiet                    -> [] (clean)
python3 -m py_compile skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py -> OK (valid Python)

Same class of bug as CG-0MSXL2L0T009CA3I (ruff mis-parsing .ts files, 627 false positives) — fixed for ruff but not for eslint.

## Suggested fix

- Filter the scoped `files` list in `_run_eslint_findings_check` / `_run_eslint_fix_mode` to JS/TS extensions (.js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs, .ts, .tsx) before building the eslint command; skip eslint entirely (return []) when no JS/TS targets remain — mirror the ruff guard.
- Whole-project mode (empty/absent files list) already avoids the issue: `eslint <root>` with no explicit targets only lints default JS extensions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Scoped eslint runs filter file targets to JS/TS extensions; a .py-only changed-file list produces zero eslint findings (eslint skipped or given no JS/TS targets).
- [ ] Unit test asserts no eslint invocation / no findings when the scoped file list contains only non-JS/TS files.
- [ ] An audit whose changed-file scope contains only .py files completes without an eslint "Parsing error" blocking finding (regression).
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **SA-0MS1TD0U70018IXR** – Clean remaining references and verify test suite (completed)
- **SA-0MUAG0C7P008X3SE** – Update tests: migrate existing tests, add AC1-AC7 coverage (open)
- **SA-0MSQ012QG005N22S** – Test runner: pytest not found on PATH in non-login shells (open)

### Repository file matches
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — matched: 0mskm2lsp006l0k8, absent, acceptance, already, audit (+121 more)
- `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — matched: 0mskm2lsp006l0k8, absent, acceptance, already, asserts (+114 more)
- `skill/audit/SKILL.md` — matched: 0mskm2lsp006l0k8, absent, acceptance, already, audit (+102 more)
data.title: audit code-quality scan: eslint gets .py targets (no extension filter) -> false high-severity blocking findings

data.description:
## Problem statement

The refactor skill's auto-fix path invokes the bare `eslint` binary. On this
machine that resolves to a legacy system eslint (v6.x) which reads
`.eslintrc.json` and has no TypeScript parser, so every `.ts`/`.tsx` file
produces an unavoidable "Parsing error" and pollutes code-quality output with
false findings.

## Users

Engineering team members and AI agents running `/skill:refactor` (including the
scheduled refactor run).

**User stories:**
- As an agent running the refactor skill, I want eslint auto-fix to use the
  project's configured eslint (flat config + TypeScript parser) so JS/TS files
  are linted correctly.
- As a producer reviewing refactor output, I want no false "Parsing error"
  findings caused by the wrong eslint binary.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `_build_eslint_fix_cmd()` returns a command beginning `npx eslint` (not the
   bare `eslint`), preserving the existing `--fix --format json --quiet` flags
   and the supplied file list.
2. `auto_fix_files()` continues to dispatch the eslint fix command for JS/TS
   files through `_build_eslint_fix_cmd()`.
3. Existing refactor auto-fix tests pass (`tests/test_refactor/test_auto_fix.py`).
4. The full project test suite passes.

## Constraints

- No behavioural change for ruff/other linters.
- No new dependency; `npx` is already available in the toolchain.

## Risks & Assumptions

- Assumption: `npx eslint` resolves the project-local eslint from
  `node_modules` (or fetches a compatible version), which loads
  `eslint.config.js` with the TypeScript parser.
- Risk: without network access and without a local eslint, `npx` may fail; the
  existing `probe_linter` gate marks eslint unavailable in that case.
data.title: Refactor skill: run eslint via npx so project flat config and TypeScript parser are used

data.description:
## Goal

Promote the current `dev` branch to `main` through the gated ship workflow,
publishing all `in_review` work accumulated since the last release.

## Users

**User stories:**
- As a producer, I want `dev` promoted to `main` via the gated, PR-based release
  so all shipped work is published and versioned.
- As an operator, I want each release gating step recorded (merge hash, PR URL)
  on a tracking work item.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. All ship gating checks pass (unmerged branches, audit readiness, critical
   items, worklog refs, producer review, final validation).
2. A `--no-ff` merge commit promotes `dev` to `main` via a PR.
3. The release is verified: tag `v<version>` exists on origin and is an ancestor
   of `origin/main`.
4. `dev` is synced with `main` after the merge.
5. The merge hash and PR URL are recorded on this work item.
6. Eligible `in_review`/`completed` items (`needsProducerReview=false`) are
   closed.

## Constraints

- No direct pushes to `main`; release only via the PR merge.
- No bypass of required status checks.

## Risks & Assumptions

- Assumption: the four producer-review-flagged items are approved before the
  release is re-run.
data.title: Release: promote dev -> main

data.comment: Blocks release SA-0MUDUY198004SS1M (audit gate exit 6). Verified root cause: skill/code_review/scripts/linter_runner.py:351,353 (and skill/code-review/scripts/linter_runner.py:207) invokes the bare 'eslint' binary, which resolves to system eslint v6.4.0. v6 ignores eslint.config.js (flat config, v9+) and uses legacy .eslintrc.json, so it parses .py/.md files as JS and emits false high-severity 'Parsing error' findings. Confirmed: 'eslint skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py' -> Parsing error: Unterminated string constant; 'npx eslint skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py' -> [] (flat config ignores non-JS). Proposed fix: invoke via npx eslint (as done for the refactor skill in SA-0MUDUXXMK006ANA0). Blocked item: SA-0MSISKM8F004NW1U (audit Ready to close: No purely from these false positives).
